info.name: Shellafood API — Official Collection
info.description:
# Shellafood API — Official Collection

## Overview
This collection covers all backend endpoints powering the Shellafood app, organized by screen. Each folder maps to a page in the app and lists every API that drives it.

---

## Setup Instructions
1. Import this file into Postman
2. Import `shellafood-environment.json` (or create environment manually)
3. Set `backend_url` to your target environment (staging or production)
4. Set `zone_id` — default is `[2]`
5. Set `module_id` to the module you are testing (e.g. `6` for Restaurants, `3` for Hypermarket)
6. For authenticated endpoints, run **Auth Flow → Send OTP → Verify OTP** first — the `token` variable is auto-saved by the test script

---

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `backend_url` | Base URL for the backend | `https://shellafood.com` |
| `zone_id` | Delivery zone (JSON array) | `[2]` |
| `module_id` | Active module for scoped requests | `6` |
| `latitude` | User latitude for distance sorting | `24.567752` |
| `longitude` | User longitude for distance sorting | `46.5444937` |
| `limit` | Default page size | `12` |
| `offset` | Default page offset | `0` |
| `token` | Bearer token — auto-set after Verify OTP | |
| `registration_token` | Temp token for new user registration — auto-set | |
| `phone` | Phone number for OTP auth | |
| `otp` | OTP code received by SMS | |

---

## Common Headers

| Header | Required By | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `zoneId` | Most endpoints | `[2]` |
| `moduleId` | Module-scoped endpoints | `6` |
| `latitude` | Store/distance endpoints | `24.567752` |
| `longitude` | Store/distance endpoints | `46.5444937` |
| `X-Localization` | All endpoints (Arabic support) | `ar` or `en` |
| `Authorization` | Authenticated endpoints | `Bearer {{token}}` |

---

## Screen Map

| # | Screen | Route | Folder |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | Home | `/home` | 01 — Home Page |
| 02 | Module | `/modules/:id` | 02 — Module Page |
| 03 | Auth | `/auth` | 03 — Auth Flow |
| 04 | Search | `/search` | 04 — Search Page |
| 05 | Store Details | `/stores/:id` | 05 — Store Details Page |

variable.description: Base URL — change to staging URL when testing against staging environment
Delivery zone ID as JSON array — used in zoneId header
Active module — 6 = Restaurants, 3 = Hypermarket, 8 = Pharmacy. Change when switching modules.
User latitude — used for distance sorting on store endpoints
User longitude — used for distance sorting on store endpoints
Default page size for paginated endpoints
Default page offset for paginated endpoints (0-based)
Bearer token — auto-populated after Verify OTP succeeds. Use in Authorization header.
Temporary token for new user registration — auto-populated after Verify OTP when user is new.
Phone number used for OTP authentication (e.g. +966512345678)
OTP code received by SMS — fill in after Send OTP
Store ID — used in store detail, menu, and category endpoints
Language for localized content — ar or en

item.name: 01 — Home Page
item.description:
All API calls that power the Home screen (`/home`).

**Sections on this screen:**
- Promo banner carousel
- Service modules grid (خدماتنا)
- Discounted stores row (عروض المتاجر)
- Current offers section (العروض الحالية) — all modules, no `moduleId`
- Recent orders (أعد طلبك — requires login) — all modules, no `moduleId`

**Note:** Banners, Modules, and Discounted Stores can be called in parallel on page load. Recent Orders requires a valid `token`. For module-scoped Current Offers or Recent Orders, use **02 — Module Page**.

item.name: 02 — Module Page
item.description:
All API calls that power a Module screen (`/modules/:id`).

**Sections on this screen:**
- Offers banner carousel
- Current offers row (العروض الحالية) — requires `moduleId` header
- Recent orders (أعد طلبك — requires login + `moduleId` header)
- Popular brands grid (أشهر العلامات التجارية)
- Categories horizontal scroll
- Paginated store grid with optional filters (`GET /api/v2/stores`)

**Important:** Current Offers and Recent Orders require the `moduleId` header set to `{{module_id}}`. The store grid uses `module_id` as a query param plus optional filter params (`category_id`, `free_delivery`, `top_rated`, `under_30_min`, `open_now`, `has_offer`). Set `{{module_id}}` in your environment before running.

**Module IDs:**
- `3` — Hypermarket
- `6` — Restaurants
- `8` — Pharmacy

- `discount_type` — `percent` or `amount`
- `module_id` — which module this offer belongs to

**Difference from Home:** Home → Current Offers returns offers across all modules with **no** `moduleId` header.

request.description:
Powers the paginated store grid and filter chips at the bottom of the Module screen.

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v2/stores`

**App proxy:** `GET /api/module/stores?module_id={{module_id}}&limit=12&offset=0`

**Returns:** Paginated stores scoped to the given module and zone, with `total_size`, `limit`, and `offset`.

**Pagination:** Use `offset` as skip count — for page 2 with `limit=12`, send `offset=12`. For page 3, `offset=24`.

**Query params (filters are all optional and combinable):**

| Param | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `module_id` | `6` | Scope to module (Restaurants) |
| `limit` | `12` | Page size |
| `offset` | `0` | Skip count |
| `category_id` | `12` | Specific category |
| `free_delivery` | `1` | Free delivery only |
| `top_rated` | `1` | Top rated only |
| `under_30_min` | `1` | Delivery within 30 min |
| `open_now` | `1` | Open now only |
| `has_offer` | `1` | Stores with offers |

**Examples:**
- No filters: `/api/v2/stores?module_id=6&limit=12&offset=0`
- Category: `/api/v2/stores?module_id=6&category_id=12`
- Combined: `/api/v2/stores?module_id=6&top_rated=1&has_offer=1`

Enable optional query params in Postman to test individual filters.

item.name: 03 — Auth Flow
item.description:
Authentication flow — run these requests **in order** (steps 1 → 4).

**Flow summary:**
1. (Optional) Guest Request — anonymous session
2. Send OTP — sends SMS code to phone
3. Verify OTP — returns `token` (existing user) or `registration_token` (new user)
4. Register — only for new users who got `registration_token` in step 3

**Tokens are auto-saved** by test scripts:
- `{{token}}` — saved automatically after Verify OTP succeeds for existing users
- `{{registration_token}}` — saved automatically for new users, used in Register step

**After completing this flow**, all authenticated endpoints (e.g. Recent Orders) will work automatically using `{{token}}`.

request.description:
Creates an anonymous guest session. This step is **optional** — skip if the user proceeds directly to phone login.

**Returns:** Guest token for tracking anonymous activity before sign-in.

Sends a one-time password (OTP) via SMS to the provided phone number.

**Before running:** Set `{{phone}}` in your environment or collection variables (e.g. `+966512345678`).

**Returns:** Success confirmation. The OTP will arrive by SMS — paste it into `{{otp}}` then run Step 3.

exec: console.log('OTP sent to ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('phone') + '. Set {{otp}} then run Verify OTP.');

request.description:
Verifies the OTP code received in Step 2.

**Before running:** Fill in `{{otp}}` with the code received by SMS.

**Two possible responses:**
- **Existing user** → returns `token` — saved automatically to `{{token}}`
- **New user** → returns `registration_token` — saved automatically to `{{registration_token}}`, proceed to Step 4

**After this step:** `{{token}}` or `{{registration_token}}` will be auto-populated by the test script.

exec: pm.test('Response contains token or registration_token', function () {
console.log('Existing user — token saved to {{token}}. Auth complete.');
console.log('New user — registration_token saved. Run Step 4 — Register to complete sign-up.');

request.description:
Completes registration for new users.

**Only run this step if Step 3 returned a `registration_token`** — existing users who got a `token` in Step 3 are already authenticated and can skip this.

**Requires:** `{{registration_token}}` (auto-set by Step 3) and `{{phone}}`.

**Returns:** `token` — saved automatically to `{{token}}`.

item.name: 04 — Search Page
item.description:
All API calls that power the Search screen (`/search`).

**Sections on this screen:**
- Search bar (user types query)
- Popular searches — الأكثر بحثًا (trending keywords)
- Popular brands — أشهر العلامات التجارية

**Note:** Popular Searches and Popular Brands load when the search page opens, before the user types anything. The search bar query itself uses a separate endpoint (TBD).

**Popular Brands** uses the same endpoint as the Module page — with or without `moduleId` header.

header.description: Required — scopes results to user's zone
ar or en — controls keyword language

query.description: Number of keywords to return — app uses 10, max 20
Optional — filter popular searches by module (e.g. 6 for Restaurants)

request.description:
Powers the **الأكثر بحثًا** (Most Searched) section on the Search screen.

**How it works:** Returns store names ranked by how frequently users have searched for them. Results are derived from a search log that tracks every search query.

**Returns:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    { "keyword": "ماكدونالدز", "count": 142 },
    { "keyword": "شاورما",     "count": 98  }
  ]
}
```

**Fallback:** If search log has insufficient data, returns top stores by `order_count` instead.

**Cache:** Results are cached for 30 minutes. `zoneId` and `module_id` are included in the cache key.

**Before running:** Set `{{store_id}}` to the store you want to inspect (default `1`).

**App proxies:**
- Full page: `GET /api/store?id={{store_id}}`
- Categories only: TBD

request.description:
Returns only the category fields needed for the store categories grid on the Store Details screen.

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v2/stores/{store_id}/categories`

**Headers:** `zoneId`, `X-Localization`, and `Accept-Language` are required. No `moduleId` header is needed.

**Returns:** A flat array of category objects — no wrapper object.
```json
[
  {
    "id": 2,
    "name": "الألبان والبيض",
    "full_image_url": "https://images.todoorstep.com/app-assets/categoryicons/subcategory/dairy_eggs.png"
  },
  {
    "id": 3,

    "full_image_url": "https://images.todoorstep.com/app-assets/categoryicons/subcategory/fish_seafood.png"
  }
]
```

**Use when:** You only need to load or refresh the categories grid without fetching the full store details payload.
